profile.headline: Modernizing systems and accelerating software delivery at enterprise scale
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience modernizing cloud platforms and leading distributed systems initiatives. Architected and evolved multi-tenant delivery platforms using CQRS, Event Sourcing, and GitOps automation to improve reliability, scalability, and security. Adept at collaborating across product and engineering to deliver resilient, developer-focused systems, drive automation best practices, and accelerate safe, efficient software delivery.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (L6)
positions.description:
Technical lead responsible for the architecture and evolution of EMS (multi-tenant provisioning platform) and DCODNext (next-gen automation framework), managing 230+ Azure subscriptions across a multi-region Hub-Spoke architecture. Partnered with Product and Engineering leadership to shape roadmaps and deliver large-scale automation initiatives.

- Architecture & Strategy: Designed and scaled EMS Control Plane and DCODNext provisioning platforms, leveraging CQRS + Event Sourcing, Open Telemetry, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code to standardize provisioning, ensuring reliability, auditability, and security at scale.

- Delivery Acceleration: Automated full network rollouts for new regions and customers provisioning — reducing delivery time from weeks (requiring multiple engineers) to minutes with self-documenting code. Drove orchestration and design standards, enabling faster adoption across teams.

- Cost Optimization: Consolidated Azure DevOps agents across regions into a single pool, cutting agent usage by 80% and reducing operational costs of EMS.

- Developer Experience: Designed and led implementation of the EMS Backstage plugin, improving usability and accelerating onboarding.

- Leadership & Mentorship: Mentored and supervised 4 contractors, and 5 FTEs, strengthening technical skills and establishing engineering best practices across the organization.

- Innovation & Recognition: Twice recognized at company-wide AI Hackathons (1st and 2nd prize), including building AI-generated documentation of all DCODNext subscriptions and real-time voice customer support agents.

- Enterprise Impact: Supported Duck Creek’s CNE strategy by helping design and roll out the company-wide shared AKS fleet.

Impact: Accelerated Duck Creek’s automation strategy, cut provisioning costs, improved delivery speed from weeks to minutes, and scaled cloud infrastructure automation across hundreds of subscriptions and regions
positions.insights: Skills: CI/CD & Automation at Scale · Leadership · Distributed Systems · Creativity and Innovation · Cloud Infrastructure

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
As Principal Software Engineer at UKG, I guided the architecture and evolution of UKG’s in-house CI/CD platform (Quark) and helped with its adoption by over 1,000 developers across 200 teams.
- Partnered with other leads and architects to align technology adoption and platform scalability with company-wide goals.
- Continued the support and enhancement of core libraries to support a CQRS+Event Sourcing platform with more than 50 microservices running in Kubernetes and backed by MongoDB, Kafka, Open Telemetry, GitOps, GitHub Runners, among others.

Impact: The wide adoption of the CI/CD platform led to a significant improvement of the Deployment Frequency, the Lead Time for Changes and Mean Time to Recovery of the company. Although these metrics were different for each team, it was a positive gain for every team.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
As Lead Software Engineer at UKG I led the development of key complex features for UKG’s CI/CD platform and helped with the adoption across the entire company. 
- Designed and built a new secrets management system that increase system reliability by 30%
- Drove the migration/and rollback strategy to the new secrets management with zero downtime through the adoption of Launch Darkly features flags. 
- Reduced the time to make new changes in the GitOps repository available to the system by 70%
- Added the ability to run terraform deployments through the platform.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Led the design and delivery of a completely redesigned Booking Engine for ncl.com, one of the company’s highest-value systems.
- Owned product architecture and led the development team in delivering the new Booking Engine.
- Achieved a 12% increase in client conversions and sales after replacing the legacy engine.
- Established best practices for scalable, resilient web architectures, ensuring system reliability under heavy load.
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership · Distributed Systems · Creativity and Innovation · Cloud Infrastructure

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Drove modernization initiatives of NCL’s digital platforms by introducing reactive microservices with Scala, Akka HTTP, and Play Framework.
- Designed and implemented resilient Booking Engine backend services, a core revenue system.
- Championed quality initiatives: unit + E2E tests, achieving 90% coverage and performance testing with Gatling.
- Partnered with Lightbend to adopt advanced Scala/Akka practices, setting engineering standards across the company.

Impact: Increased booking reliability, scalability, and sales performance while establishing modern engineering practices across NCL.

positions.title: Senior Application Engineer
positions.description: Lead developer and main point of contact for multiple key segments of the platform like security, customer's billing, third parties integrations and others. Actively participating in the design and development of new features as well as current architecture enhancements. When is needed I directly assist clients with advanced integrations requiring development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Rex Three  is a commercial offset and digital printing, packaging fulfillment and shipping company. In a very short time I became a valuable asset for the company creating new services to improve key processes and support general operations. Delivered three major projects for the company, two of them revolutionized the printing and shipping processes providing a never before seen performance and scalability, reducing production timeframes and  increasing overall company sales; the third project was a public platform for Topps, a major baseball trading cards producer and distributor, in this project I served also as point of contact to get requirements, make all technical decisions and build the Statement of Work prior to the development.

positions.title: Senior Laravel Developer
positions.description: The Cloud Studio is an small marketing and development agency located in Belgium. As part of a small company I was required to take care of much more than just development, I was In charge of the full software life cycle of multiple complex CRM and websites for important brands in Belgium, from requirements capture with the clients to the development, testing and deployment to production. As part of a talented young and passionate team of professionals, I was driven to achieve excellent user experience, code usability and extensibility, performance and robustness.

positions.title: Senior DevOp
positions.description:
Worked as Senior DevOp Specialist in the State’s University Data Center: developing, installing and maintaining high performance and scalable applications used by more than 50k users from all the Universities in the country, managing virtualization environments and services and getting trained in a real data center daily workouts. 
Worked as Professor teaching artificial intelligence and Data mining to Computer Science students

company.name: IT Department University of Pinar del Rio

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
Co-founder, DevOp, architect and lead developer of a small company running marketing business with complex software and services architecture to guarantee scalability, high availability and performance with distributed storage, failover and load balance strategies. Successfully served many clients around the world driving multi-channel marketing campaigns with real time results. 
This project was recognized with the Startup of the Year award in 2014 by the Latino Chamber of Commerce of Los Angeles.

courses.name: 30 Days DevOp Training at Ghent University, Belgium
